mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates applied to future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 10.0% over a single month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, increasing the risk of recession and prompting equity investors to demand higher risk premiums, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction permits and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction effect's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above 100.5 index points over two consecutive months indicates strong supply-side momentum, which correlates with rising corporate profitability and positive earnings revisions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% combined with a stable or rising CPIAUCSL indicates a tightening monetary policy stance in the face of persistent inflation, increasing real borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when both triggers are met, or the interaction effect's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a drop in industrial production signals a broad-based demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue visibility and triggering risk-off behavior in equity markets, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 50% of instances when both RSAFS and INDPRO decline, or the interaction effect's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate above 10.0% and a decline in non-farm payrolls below 130,000 indicates a labor market collapse, increasing recession risk and prompting equity investors to reduce exposure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when both triggers are met, or the interaction effect's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in residential construction permits below 570,000 units over two consecutive months signals weakening housing demand, which is a leading indicator of broader consumer spending weakness and reduced corporate capital investment, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.
